business_context.summary: Multiple organizations must use the platform independently.

architecture_drivers.statement: Multiple organizations must use the platform independently.

constraints.statement: Team of four engineers; PostgreSQL already in production.

architecture_options.name: Shared schema with tenant_id
architecture_options.trade_off: Lowest cost; isolation depends on consistent enforcement.

architecture_options.name: Schema per tenant
architecture_options.trade_off: Stronger isolation; higher migration and operational effort.

selected_architecture.rationale: Small team; no evidence that independent scaling is needed.

components.name: Tenant Context Layer
components.responsibility: Carry tenant identity to every data access

data_architecture.note: Tenant boundary not visible in the data access layer.

security_architecture.secrets: Secret stored in environment-based secret manager.

observability.status: No monitoring configuration was found in the inspected repository.

decisions.title: Introduce explicit tenant context at the data-access boundary

risks.risk: Cross-tenant data exposure if tenant boundaries are not enforced consistently
risks.mitigation: Tenant context layer plus isolation tests
risks.contingency: Disable affected endpoints and audit access logs

assumptions: Runtime authorization behavior was not verified.
open_questions: Is row-level security acceptable to the team?
